subject: História
description_pt: Identificar e organizar, temporalmente, fatos da vida cotidiana, usando noções relacionadas ao tempo (antes, durante, ao mesmo tempo e depois).

components.description_pt: Aplicar conceitos temporais — antes, durante, ao mesmo tempo e depois — a eventos diários
components.description_en: Apply temporal concepts — before, during, at the same time, and after — to daily events
components.cc_component_description: Use temporal words and phrases to sequence events in a narrative

components.description_pt: Organizar eventos da vida diária em ordem cronológica
components.description_en: Organize events from daily life in chronological order
components.cc_component_description: Sequence events from stories and narratives in correct order

components.description_pt: Identificar a sequência de eventos usando vocabulário apropriado relacionado ao tempo
components.description_en: Identify the sequence of events using appropriate time-related vocabulary
components.cc_component_description: Identify transitional words and phrases that signal sequence of events in narrative writing

cc_matches.description: Use a variety of transitional words and phrases to manage the sequence of events.
Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar relatos para...
* discernir contextos decuentos e historias
* ordenar los eventos decuentos e historias
* identificar detalles clave en textos multimodales bilingües
* deducir los significados depalabras y expresiones queno reconocen
* considerar ideas a base delas de otros
